description: Search the Capital Health sports nutrition catalog, compare current prices in Russian rubles, review product details and alternatives, and build a shopping list. Choose a delivery region, confirm items and quantities, then open a 24-hour link to sign in to Capital Health, import the list into the cart, and complete checkout. Capital Health sells physical goods. The plugin does not provide medical advice, store customer accounts or payment details, reserve stock, or lock prices.

defaultPrompt: Найди протеин в каталоге Capital Health для Москвы до 3000 рублей.
Сравни два доступных товара Capital Health по цене и описанию производителя.
После моего подтверждения создай ссылку на выбранные товары Capital Health.
